open_items: T11 references (7 in-band 10N kills, 2024-10, raid item level 354.9-359.9, 131-171 s) are in the new magmaw_wcl_dps_reference_t11_v1.json. Per-spec targets (median, kills): Blood DK 17,717 (7), Balance 20,436 (3), Survival 27,410 (4), Fire 23,396 (5), Retribution 23,552 (4), Assassination 25,288 (4), Elemental 23,683 (4), Demonology 20,651 (4). No WoWSims fallback remains. Raid DPS median 173,524. The legacy target, its manifest and its cast timelines are untouched because the accepted b5-d1898555 verdict pins all three sha256s. The raid target file therefore cannot carry the new matched_reference_ids. The c0 variant takes them through the roster-variant sidecar, which needs the coordinator patches below; until they land, c0 labels are still judged against Y8ajQ7dbmKMG1RZy-fight22 (395.33) plus WoWSims.

New cast timelines magmaw_wcl_cast_timelines_t11_v1.json: fTCjtgrnzm4HRwXP-27 (BDK, Balance, Survival, Fire, Assassination, Demonology) plus RtPXnbZxFkpacw1h-6 (Ret, Elemental) as additional_references. Every actor page is complete.

encounter_research: 10N is accepted (contract and ledger fidelity_state_by_mode {10N: accepted}). Read-only `raid_workloop program status --boss magmaw` now reports research fidelity_state accepted and missing_inputs []. The contract-level state stays fidelity_blocked. Unresolved claims go from 8 to 7, each scoped to 10H/25N/25H. Evidence: 7 T11 kills (enemy casts, auras, Mangle/Armor, head damage, tank melee U, Magma Spit rows), the official Cataclysm Classic hotfix thread (only Magmaw entry is 2024-06-13), 4.4.2 client spell rows (Impale Self 6 s cast / 30 s; Launch Hook 3 s auras), and Wowhead N10 loot plus Parasite Evening. The catalog count patch below is required; without it test_all_catalog_triplets_reconcile_identity_and_fail_closed fails (8 != 7).

Native comparison found no 10N timer or mechanic mismatch, so boss_magmaw.cpp is unchanged. Mangle 90.2-90.8 s; Crash begins 8.1-8.5 s later; Spew first at 19.8-24.7 s, repeats 22.7-32.4 s; Pillars at ~32 and 63-68 s; Spew and Pillar resume 3.6-4.4 s and 7.7-8.5 s after head cover. Mangle is released by the impale 22.6-27.5 s after it lands, with Armor at the same ms and head damage 0.1-1.4 s later; the native head window matches within about 2 s. DamageModifier 16 is corroborated by 2 more T11 kills. No 10N reference reached a second Mangle (native 95 s repeat; 25H WCL 95.558 s).

Non-combat gap: Wowhead lists the quest item Soothsayer's Runes 71716 (44%) for Magmaw N10; world DB reference loot 415700 has only the 12 gear items (all match). Recorded under the ledger's known_repository_gaps; no SQL staged, because its quest condition is unresearched.

Strategy fix (owned C++): melee DPS on the Exposed Head. Ret and Assassination never had a PreferredCombatRange, so the ranged head hold never admitted them, and the Mechanic ranged_formation_restore (priority 275) pulled them to the support anchor for the whole head window. MeleeHeadAttacker now lets a melee DPS whose damage target is the head keep normal melee closure; hazards, hooks and pillars still win. A compiled harness test fails without the fix and passes with it. Round 3 is the first canonical run whose kills reach the head window.

Audit (static, not fixed; watch in the round-3 trace). (A) Hook launch is gated on seats, not the mount window. After the first successful pair, both riders may keep submitting launch_native_hook for up to 3.5 s before the eject, which could re-trigger ACTION_IMPALE_MAGMAW and restart Impale Self. Check the trace for launch_native_hook after the first impale. Gating on boss.Interactable was not applied, because a late hook after the window closes is native behavior (fDP4 and fTCj resumed Spew during Mangle and still impaled). (B) With real deaths, a dead baiter never 'arrives', so the lane transition can keep the survivor on the previous wave's endpoint for later waves; SingleMage has no replacement. (C) was fixed as above. No clear second-Mangle, wave-3+ or bloodlust bug was found.

Fire at 94% (round 2) and the Demonology gap were measured at 409 gear and are not comparable with the T11 targets. Numbers were not tuned; round 3 gives the first T11 data. Re-evaluating the round-2 c0 label under the new sidecar gives pass for every actor (409-gear DPS against T11 targets). That result is not evidence; acceptance must come from round-3 T11-gear labels.

WCL route: `codex exec -m gpt-6.1-sol` in one own tab of the user's Chrome, 2026-09-30 10:38-11:58 UTC, no verification check. The first two parallel tasks lost the plugin connection after 4-6 page loads (cua_repl/js failures). They resumed sequentially from their saved partial JSON and completed. Raw captures are in ~/.cache/magmaw_wcl; DVC archive requested below.

risks: Accepting 10N research rests on WCL rows plus native source comparison. The acceptance observations (hook arrival within the 3 s overlap, one impale per Mangle, head window, a second Mangle at ~185 s, Armor on the sole tank at Mangle 2) are unexecuted, and round 3 is the first canonical run long enough to reach them.

The melee head hold changes melee movement during the head window. If the head is unreachable by pathing from where melee stand, they could chase the head instead of restoring formation. Hazard, hook and pillar movement still preempt it. Legacy Magmaw (no melee DPS), Stonecore and calibration are unaffected.

Once the sidecar patch lands, re-evaluating round-1/2 c0 labels uses T11 targets. Their saved verdicts pin the old sidecar sha, so graph_acceptance treats them as stale, which is intended. Fresh re-evaluation of 409-gear labels shows pass and must not be cited.
Balance has only 3 matched kills (parse 46-77); every other spec has 4-7.
Audit item B (dead baiter stalls the lane) is more likely now that deaths are real and fights are longer.
validation_neutrality: The legacy Magmaw target, WCL manifest and cast timelines are byte-identical, and the b5-d1898555 verdict re-evaluates byte-identically with all requested patches applied (shadow-root check). test_magmaw_b5_verdict_stays_byte_identical passes. The owned C++ change only affects dps-role actors whose spec is outside the ranged list and who have no configured combat range. The legacy roster (Balance, 2x Fire, Affliction, Survival, Elemental) has none, so legacy Magmaw behavior, Stonecore and calibration do not shift. Nothing was changed in boss_magmaw.cpp, SQL, DamageModifier, the fidelity registry or the roster. Nothing was committed or built, no worldserver was run, and there was no dvc push.

needs_user_decision.question: On the canonical BWD 10N roster, which has one Fire Mage and one Survival Hunter, should the Fire Mage keep baiting every Lava Parasite wave together with the hunter, or should the hunter bait alternate waves alone?
needs_user_decision.context: The bait rotation (DPS-064) alternates the Blink lane between two Fire Mages. The canonical roster has one, so it baits every wave (single_mage). At 409 gear, bait duty cost the mage about 4k DPS; Fire was at 94% in round 2. Round-3 T11 fights have 2-3 parasite waves (Pillars at ~32, ~65 and ~153 s), and the Fire target drops to 23,396 (T11 WCL). A hunter-only wave needs a vacant-mage-slot mode in the lane transition, plus a stable hook-rider list, and has not been built or validated.
options: Keep the Fire Mage baiting every wave with the hunter (current behavior)
Hunter baits alternate waves alone; the Fire Mage stays on Magmaw (needs implementation and a 5-kill batch)
Another tactic you use for parasites in 10N (for example ranged kill them in place without baiting)
needs_user_decision.recommendation: Keep the current behavior for round 3 and decide once the first T11 Fire numbers are in. At the new target the bait cost may no longer matter.
